messages.content: "Can you help me find a property in San Francisco, CA that is a condo with 2 bedrooms and fits within my budget range of $500,000 to $800,000? After that, could you also provide an estimated value for a villa in Los Angeles, CA with 3 bedrooms that is 5 years old? Lastly, I would also like to know the estimated value of an apartment in New York, NY with 1 bedroom that is 10 years old."

function.name: property_valuation_get
function.description: Get estimated value of a property based on location, specifications and age Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: City and state where the property is located, e.g. San Diego, CA.

propertyType.description: Type of property such as villa, condo, apartment, etc.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms required in the property.

age.description: Age of the property in years.

function.name: realestate_find_properties
function.description: Find properties based on location, budget, and specifications Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: City and state where the property is located, e.g. San Diego, CA.

propertyType.description: Type of property such as villa, condo, apartment, etc.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms required in the property.

min.description: Minimum budget limit. This is a float type value.

max.description: Maximum budget limit. This is a float type value.
